<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- iPhone status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#060606">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="14" x2="322" y2="18" stroke="#060606" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="12" x2="327" y2="18" stroke="#060606" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="10" x2="332" y2="18" stroke="#060606" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="8" x2="337" y2="18" stroke="#060606" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#060606" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="14" x2="353" y2="14" stroke="#060606" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="8" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#060606" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="10" width="17" height="8" rx="2" fill="#060606"/>
    <rect x="386" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#060606"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top app bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="56" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points=" thirty" fill="none" stroke="none"/>
  <polyline points="28,55 21,62 28,69" fill="none" stroke="#161722" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="21" y1="62" x2="39" y2="62" stroke="#161722" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#161722">Direct messages</text>
  <line x1="366" y1="55" x2="366" y2="69" stroke="#161722" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="359" y1="62" x2="373" y2="62" stroke="#161722" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="84" x2="390" y2="84" stroke="#E8E8E7" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- empty state surface -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="35" y="147" width="320" height="450" rx="18" fill="#FBFBFB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- message illustration -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="260" r="70" fill="#F5F5F4"/>
  <rect x="151" y="222" width="88" height="66" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E8E7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="168,286 167,306 187,288" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E8E7" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="174" cy="255" r="5" fill="#65D2E9"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="255" r="5" fill="#E6436D"/>
  <circle cx="216" cy="255" r="5" fill="#FFA800"/>
  <line x1="174" y1="273" x2="216" y2="273" stroke="#ABABAB" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <text x="195" y="360" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="800" fill="#161722">No messages yet</text>
  <text x="195" y="391" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#86878B">Connect with friends and start</text>
  <text x="195" y="413" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#86878B">a conversation.</text>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="101" y="449" width="188" height="44" rx="22" fill="#EA4359"/>
    <text x="195" y="477" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Find friends</text>
  </g>

  <!-- secondary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="116" y="509" width="158" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E8E7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="536" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#455154">Invite friends</text>
  </g>

  <!-- small supporting row -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="626" r="20" fill="#65D2E9"/>
  <text x="70" y="632" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">A</text>
  <text x="102" y="623" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#455154">Messages from friends appear here</text>
  <text x="102" y="642" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#86878B">Keep in touch through direct chat.</text>
  <line x1="35" y1="672" x2="355" y2="672" stroke="#E8E8E7" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="76" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="744" x2="390" y2="744" stroke="#E8E8E7" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="35,769 47,759 59,769 59,783 35,783" fill="none" stroke="#86878B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="32,769 47,756 62,769" fill="none" stroke="#86878B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="47" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#86878B">Home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Discover -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="125" cy="770" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#86878B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="125" y1="763" x2="125" y2="777" stroke="#86878B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="118" y1="770" x2="132" y2="770" stroke="#86878B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="125" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#86878B">Discover</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Create -->
  <g>
    <rect x="178" y="758" width="34" height="24" rx="7" fill="#161722"/>
    <line x1="185" y1="770" x2="205" y2="770" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="763" x2="195" y2="777" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#86878B">Create</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Inbox active -->
  <g>
    <rect x="263" y="759" width="25" height="21" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#EA4359" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="269,780 269,785 276,780" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA4359" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="270" cy="769" r="2" fill="#EA4359"/>
    <circle cx="276" cy="769" r="2" fill="#EA4359"/>
    <circle cx="282" cy="769" r="2" fill="#EA4359"/>
    <text x="275" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#EA4359">Inbox</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="345" cy="765" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#86878B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="780" rx="13" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#86878B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="345" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#86878B">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- iPhone home indicator -->
  <rect x="142" y="829" width="106" height="5" rx="3" fill="#060606"/>
</svg>
